# 证件水印助手 / Watermark Assistant

证件水印助手可为身份证、证件照、营业执照、合同和文件图片添加隐私文字水印。Chrome 浏览器本地处理，不上传服务器，支持批量保存和上传时插入。

## Core facts
- Chrome extension for adding text watermarks to ID, document and certificate photos.
- Images are processed locally in the browser.
- The extension does not upload selected images to a developer server.
- Supports batch image workflows and in-page upload insertion.

## Important URLs
- Landing page: https://yxzwork89.github.io/watermark-assistan-plugin/
- Privacy policy: https://yxzwork89.github.io/watermark-assistan-plugin/privacy.html
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/watermark-assistant/kakkpfpjhoghlhcljooobfnpegbhpahm?hl=en&utm_source=ext_sidebar
